explanation: MechanicalPhysics::solve in adamantine 1.1 (source a2e3a41) solves the global system "assuming that the deformation is elastic" and then calls compute_stress, which applies the J2 radial return to the stress only; the plastic strain is not fed back into equilibrium, so the displacement field is the elastic one whatever the yield stress.
question: Does J2 plasticity change the displacement of a lumped-layer build in adamantine 1.1?
setup: solid blank, 2 mm cells, 6 mm clamped plate, 2 lumped 2 mm layers at 1720 K from t = 1 s every 300 s, cooling to t = 600 s; identical except for the plastic inputs
